verdict.rationale: Polar documents official SDKs that give full type safety when calling its API. The Python SDK has fully typed sync and async clients, the TypeScript and Python SDKs include webhook validation helpers, and framework adapters cover checkouts and webhooks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and dedicated depth on the TypeScript SDK beyond passing mentions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Call the Polar API with full type safety using one of our official SDKs.
The official Python SDK provides fully typed synchronous and asynchronous clients for the Polar API.
Our TypeScript & Python SDKs come with a built-in helper function to easily validate and parse the webhook event
Framework adapters make it dead simple to add Polar checkouts and webhooks to your stack.
